title: ConsentGroup
description: A consent group representing a category of contact opt-in/opt-out preferences.

id.description: Unique identifier for the consent group

name.description: Display name of the consent group

description.description: Optional description of the consent group

signupMode.description: Controls how contacts are added to the group. `manual` — contacts are added explicitly via the API. `automatic` — contacts are added automatically at signup.

contactsCount.description: Number of contacts currently in this consent group

isDefault.description: Whether this is a system-created default consent group

createdAt.description: UTC date-time when the consent group was created (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

updatedAt.description: UTC date-time when the consent group was last updated (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

ConsentGroupSignupMode.description: Controls how contacts are added to the group. `manual` — contacts are added explicitly via the API. `automatic` — contacts are added automatically at signup.
ConsentGroupSignupMode.title: ConsentGroupSignupMode
